# 2 Baruch Chapter 40 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**40:1** And-the-dominion-of-my-Anointed-One which-has-been-revealed will-stand-forever, until-the-world-of-corruption-has-ended and-until-the-times-that-have-been-spoken-of-above-are-fulfilled.

**40:2** This-is-the-vision which-you-saw, and-this-is-its-interpretation.

**40:3** And-I-said: O-LORD my-Lord, will-I-also be-preserved until-those-times? Or-who-will-be-in-those-days?

**40:4** And-he-answered and-said to-me: Whatever-will-be with-you, you-will-not-know; but-whatever-concerns-you-you-will-know; for-the-Most-High has-revealed-[these things] to-you.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. Chapter 40 closes the interpretation of the cedar-vine vision and transitions to Baruch's personal question about his own preservation. God's answer is characteristically partial — what concerns you personally will be revealed; the rest remains hidden.*
